cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort the exhibition layout. I only finished one painting; tell me one is enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hang yours as planned. I need to hear that mine earns its space, not that you can cover for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put it there, then. When people arrive, will you introduce me as your fellow painter?
